instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 300°F. Pour ¼-inch water into a roasting pan; set aside.
Wash, dry, and slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard stems and place leaves in a small bowl.
Add water, peach preserves, maple syrup, and mustard to the bowl with the thyme. Whisk to combine. Add additional water, if needed, to reach a glaze-like consistency.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup peach preserves
½ cup pure maple syrup
2 tbsp wholegrain mustard

instructions.primary_message: Pat ham dry with paper towels; transfer to the roasting pan. Use toothpicks to secure the slices together, then tent ham with aluminum foil.
instructions.secondary_message: 10 lb whole ham, spiral cut, bone-in

instructions.primary_message: Place roasting pan in the oven and roast until a thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the ham registers 135°F, about 1 ½ hours, brushing with the glaze every 10-15 minutes.
Remove roasting pan from the oven and transfer ham to a cutting board. Let rest, loosely covered with foil, about 15 minutes.
